g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.desc: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.text: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.desc: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.text: NOTES (confirmed by continuity unless marked; ? = value not read)

g.desc: NOTES (confirmed by continuity unless marked; ? = value not read)

g.text: - CN100 = BLACK tab (live), CN101 = WHITE tab (neutral). CY103/CY104 Y-capacitors exist; their far ends were not traced (not drawn).

g.desc: - CN100 = BLACK tab (live), CN101 = WHITE tab (neutral). CY103/CY104 Y-capacitors exist; their far ends were not traced (not drawn).

g.text: - RY200 switches live (L_F) to NODE_Y; RY202 switches neutral (N_F) to NODE_X through three parallel jumpers JC12-JC14.

g.desc: - RY200 switches live (L_F) to NODE_Y; RY202 switches neutral (N_F) to NODE_X through three parallel jumpers JC12-JC14.

g.text: Both relays only close when the safety logic permits it.

g.desc: Both relays only close when the safety logic permits it.

g.text: - Heater path: L_F - RY200 - NODE_Y - T700 - CN703 - heater - CN704 - CR700 A1..A2 - NODE_X - RY202 - N_F. No fuse in the heater path.

g.desc: - Heater path: L_F - RY200 - NODE_Y - T700 - CN703 - heater - CN704 - CR700 A1..A2 - NODE_X - RY202 - N_F. No fuse in the heater path.

g.text: - CR700 original marking unreadable (date code 409); replaced with BTA24-600BW after the A1 leg cracked in its C-bend (2026-10).

g.desc: - CR700 original marking unreadable (date code 409); replaced with BTA24-600BW after the A1 leg cracked in its C-bend (2026-10).

g.text: Re-form the C-bend on replacement legs. T700 secondary: S1/S2 order assumed.

g.desc: Re-form the C-bend on replacement legs. T700 secondary: S1/S2 order assumed.

g.text: - The TM31 only heats while a time is set and the blade turns. 120 V bowl: heater 12.8 ohm, NTC ~130 kohm at room temperature.

g.desc: - The TM31 only heats while a time is set and the blade turns. 120 V bowl: heater 12.8 ohm, NTC ~130 kohm at room temperature.
